items.raw_excerpt: 作为 Anthropic 有史以来向公众发布的最强 AI 模型，Fable 5 仅“上线”了短短三天。它在聊天机器人竞技场排行榜上登顶，在编程基准测试中以两位数的优势碾压 OpenAI 的 GPT 5.5，并首次让付费订阅者接触到 Mythos 级别的推理能力。然后，在 6 月 12 日，特朗普政府下令 Anthropic 将其下架。

title_i18n.zh: Fable 5被禁3天后Anthropic认怂！连夜急派员工赴华盛顿谈判：GPT 5.5有同款漏洞
title_i18n.en: Fable 5 was banned for 3 days, and Anthropic backed down! They urgently sent employees to Washington overnight for negotiations: GPT 5.5 has the same vulnerability.
title_i18n.es: Tras 3 días de prohibición de Fable 5, Anthropic cede. Envían empleados de urgencia a Washington para negociar: GPT 5.5 tiene la misma vulnerabilidad.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 作为 Anthropic 有史以来向公众发布的最强 AI 模型，Fable 5 仅“上线”了短短三天。它在聊天机器人竞技场排行榜上登顶，在编程基准测试中以两位数的优势碾压 OpenAI 的 GPT 5.5，并首次让付费订阅者接触到 Mythos 级别的推理能力。然后，在 6 月 12 日，特朗普政府下令 Anthropic 将其下架。
excerpt_i18n.en: As the most powerful AI model Anthropic has ever released to the public, Fable 5 was only "live" for three days. It topped the chatbot arena leaderboard, outperformed OpenAI's GPT 5.5 by double digits in coding benchmarks, and gave paying subscribers their first access to Mythos-level reasoning capabilities. Then, on June 12, the Trump administration ordered Anthropic to take it down.
excerpt_i18n.es: Como el modelo de IA más potente jamás lanzado al público por Anthropic, Fable 5 solo estuvo "en línea" durante tres días. Alcanzó el primer puesto en la clasificación del chatbot arena, superó por un margen de dos dígitos a OpenAI GPT 5.5 en pruebas de referencia de programación, y por primera vez permitió a los suscriptores de pago acceder a capacidades de razonamiento de nivel Mythos. Luego, el 12 de junio, el gobierno de Trump ordenó a Anthropic retirarlo.

items.title: 同属 Oracle，OpenJDK 与 GraalVM 对 AI 代码贡献态度相反
items.raw_excerpt: 两个由 Oracle 支持、彼此相关的项目，针对使用生成式 AI 创建的开源贡献发布了相反的政策： OpenJDK 管理委员会批准了一项 临时政策 ，禁止此类贡献；而 GraalVM 的 Coding Assistants 政策 则允许这类贡献。两个项目都要求贡献者签署同一份 Oracle Contributor Agreement（OCA） ，用于处理知识产权相关事项。

title_i18n.zh: 同属 Oracle，OpenJDK 与 GraalVM 对 AI 代码贡献态度相反
title_i18n.en: Both under Oracle, OpenJDK and GraalVM have opposite attitudes toward contributing AI code.
title_i18n.es: Ambos pertenecen a Oracle, pero OpenJDK y GraalVM tienen posturas opuestas respecto a las contribuciones de código para IA.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 两个由 Oracle 支持、彼此相关的项目，针对使用生成式 AI 创建的开源贡献发布了相反的政策： OpenJDK 管理委员会批准了一项 临时政策 ，禁止此类贡献；而 GraalVM 的 Coding Assistants 政策 则允许这类贡献。两个项目都要求贡献者签署同一份 Oracle Contributor Agreement（OCA） ，用于处理知识产权相关事项。
excerpt_i18n.en: Two related Oracle-backed projects have issued opposing policies on open-source contributions created using generative AI: the OpenJDK Governing Board approved a temporary policy prohibiting such contributions, while GraalVM's Coding Assistants policy permits them. Both projects require contributors to sign the same Oracle Contributor Agreement (OCA) to address intellectual property matters.
excerpt_i18n.es: Dos proyectos relacionados, respaldados por Oracle, han publicado políticas opuestas sobre contribuciones de código abierto creadas con IA generativa: el comité directivo de OpenJDK aprobó una política temporal que prohíbe dichas contribuciones; mientras que la política de Coding Assistants de GraalVM las permite. Ambos proyectos exigen que los contribuyentes firmen el mismo Oracle Contributor Agreement (OCA) para gestionar asuntos relacionados con la propiedad intelectual.

excerpt_i18n.en: On June 17, during the VivaTech conference, Alibaba Cloud officially launched operations in Paris, France, and Johor, Malaysia, while expanding its data centers in Tokyo, Japan, and Mexico to meet the surging demand for AI-driven token calls in global markets. Following this expansion, Alibaba Cloud's global presence has grown to 32 regions and 105 availability zones. According to Gartner data, Alibaba Cloud is the largest cloud service provider in China and ranks first in the Asia-Pacific region. With the launch of the new Johor region, Alibaba Cloud now operates a total of five data centers in Malaysia, marking its largest infrastructure deployment in Southeast Asia to date. The new Paris region becomes Alibaba Cloud's third hub in Europe, following Germany and the UK, offering local customers lower-latency cloud and AI services. The fifth data center in Tokyo, Japan, follows the fourth one opened in March, further expanding Alibaba Cloud's service capacity in the region. Additionally, the second availability zone in Mexico has been launched, enhancing Alibaba Cloud's ability to serve local customers. On the AI product front, Alibaba Cloud announced that in the second half of this year, it will launch a comprehensive suite of Agentic AI products for the Malaysian and European markets, including: AgentRun, a one-stop intelligent agent development and construction platform; STAROps, an integrated intelligent operations platform; ACS Agent Sandbox, which provides hardware-level security isolation and reduces agent operational costs; and Agent Secur, a unified defense platform for intelligent agents.

excerpt_i18n.en:
The biggest illusion of the AI era is equating a demo with a product. A single prompt generates a beautiful page, you screenshot it and post it on social media, and it gets hundreds of likes. But when you actually show it to a client, they ask: Where are the other pages? Is the color scheme consistent? Is it adapted for mobile? Can you make a revision? The gap between a demo and a product lies in these very questions.

Within a month of Skywork 3.0's launch, the revenue of Tiangong Super Agent tripled. Behind this growth is an increasing number of users treating Tiangong as a productivity tool for delivering results.

This shift is concretely reflected in user behavior data. Among all of Tiangong's output capabilities, Websites is the scenario where users engage most deeply. Users are not satisfied with generating a single page and leaving; instead, they continuously refine around the same project: adding requirements, adjusting structures, starting over, and further detailing. Deep users average over 40 interaction rounds per single project, with many complex projects taking shape across multiple login sessions.

Most people, however, end their AI usage after just three rounds.

We found that this group of deep users employs Tiangong in a completely different way. They are not here for Q&A—they are here to build: to construct something long-term, complex, and their own. These needs are ultra-long-tail and highly personalized, impossible to achieve in a single generation—only through repeated iteration.
excerpt_i18n.es: La mayor ilusión de la era de la IA es equiparar una demo con un producto. Un prompt genera una página bonita, la capturas de pantalla y la publicas en redes sociales, y obtienes cientos de 'me gusta'. Pero cuando realmente la llevas a un cliente, este pregunta: ¿dónde están las demás páginas? ¿Los colores son uniformes? ¿Está adaptada para móviles? ¿Se puede modificar una versión? Entre una demo y un producto, la diferencia radica en estas preguntas. Un mes después del lanzamiento de Skywork 3.0, los ingresos del superagente inteligente Tiangong se triplicaron. Detrás de este crecimiento, cada vez más usuarios utilizan Tiangong como una herramienta de productividad para entregar resultados.

items.title: 犀牛鸟前沿 | 犀牛鸟精英人才 ICML 2026 入选论文解读
items.raw_excerpt: 前言 腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才计划定位拔尖科研人才的产学联合培养。自2017年开展以来，项目每年开放新技术研发中的关键难题，选拔具备科研潜力的优秀学生，在校企双导师联合指导下开展前沿探索与应用创新。 依托真实产业场景，同学们在科研探索与技术实践中不断锻炼创新研究能力，并形成了一系列高水平研究成果。本文分享入选 ICML的三篇论文，分别围绕高效模型蒸馏、长上下文推理和 稀疏视角视频生成 等技术方向展开。 Hybrid Policy Distillation for LLMs 该论文由腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才朱文红同学在上海交通大学 王瑞副教授、 刘鹏飞副教授和腾讯混元团队企业导师的联合指导下完成。 摘要： 知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation，KD）是一种用于压缩大语言模型（LLM）的强大范例，但其有效性取决于几个紧密耦合的设计选择，包括发散方向、优化策略和数据制度。我们系统地分解了现有的KD方法，并提出了一个统一的观点，揭示了它们之间的潜在联系，将KD重新表述为一个令牌级别的重加权对数似然目标。基于这一观点，我们提出了混合策略蒸馏（HPD），它结合了正向和反向KL的互补优势，以平衡模式覆盖和模式搜索，同时将非策略数据与轻量级的近似策略抽样集成在一起。我们在长形式数学推理以及短形式对话和代码生成上评估了HPD，并表明它在不同的模型族和规模上始终提高了优化稳定性、计算效率和最终性能。 ? 完整解读： 犀牛鸟前沿｜ICML 2026：腾讯混元-上海交大高效模型蒸馏最新成果解读 ? 论文链接： https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.20244 Many-Shot CoT-ICL: Making In-Context Learning Truly Learn 该论文由腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才鍾芷婷同学在香港科技大学楊瓞仁教授和腾讯微信团队企业导师的 联合指导下 完成。

Preface  
Tencent Rhino-Bird Elite Talent Program aims to cultivate top-tier research talents through industry-academia collaboration. Since its launch in 2017, the program annually releases key challenges in new technology research and development, selects outstanding students with research potential, and guides them in frontier exploration and application innovation under the joint mentorship of university and industry advisors. Leveraging real-world industry scenarios, students continuously enhance their innovative research capabilities through scientific exploration and technical practice, producing a series of high-level research outcomes. This article shares three papers accepted at ICML, focusing on efficient model distillation, long-context reasoning, and sparse-view video generation.  

Hybrid Policy Distillation for LLMs  
This paper was completed by Tencent Rhino-Bird Elite Program student Zhu Wenhong under the joint guidance of Associate Professor Wang Rui and Associate Professor Liu Pengfei from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, along with industry mentors from the Tencent Hunyuan team.

items.title: Introducing Gemma 4 models on Amazon Bedrock
items.raw_excerpt: Today, we are announcing the availability of the Gemma 4 family on Amazon Bedrock. Built by Google DeepMind and released under the Apache 2.0 license, Gemma 4 is a family of open-weight models designed with a focus on intelligence-per-parameter across a broad range of deployment scenarios. The family includes three instruction-tuned variants: Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 26B-A4B, and Gemma 4 E2B. These cover dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, where only a fraction of the model’s parameters activate per request. The variants offer built-in reasoning, native function calling, and multimodal input across text and image.
